evidence.quote: Among the 347 prostate cancer cases who reported their dietary habits, 214 were diagnosed before and 133 after completing the FFQ.

In a sensitivity analysis we used logistic regression models to calculate ORs and 95% CIs of prostate cancer for rye- and oatmeal consumption in early life for incident cases only, adjusting for the same covariates as was done in the third model.

Men consuming oatmeal more than five times per week, had an OR of 0.80 (95% CI: 0.54-1.19) for total prostate cancer and 0.93 (95% CI: 0.40-2.19) for advanced disease compared with men with low oatmeal consumption (≤4 times/ week) in adolescence.
